title: Fall of Ayutthaya
summary: Burmese forces took Ayutthaya, the Siamese royal capital for four centuries, on 7 April 1767, burning palaces and temples. Taksin retook the area that year and moved the capital to Thonburi.
why: Ended the 417-year Ayutthaya Kingdom; Siam's capital moved to Thonburi.
